checks.instruction: Confirm the exact candidate version 0.1.0 and Pixa name/icon in the installed app and About. Record the downloaded artifact SHA-256.

Inspect Home, title bar, About, menus, dialogs and installer/OS icon. No inherited product promotion, project-repository advertisement or nonexistent Discord link. Legal and contributor credits must remain.
Open the offline user manual using Help/footer and F1. Search for a known section, then a nonsense term; verify matching and empty-result feedback.

Start Quick tour or Shift+F1. There are 81 configured explanation entries. Visit each, use Back at step two, finish the final step, reopen and press Escape. Record missing/misleading explanations or missing controls.
Create a disposable unsaved edit first. Opening/closing help and the tour must not change the document, selection, active tool or dirty state.
Check normal/narrow windows, 100%/200% display scaling, hidden toolbars, grouped tools and visible highlights. A tour must not claim a hidden control is visibly highlighted.
Use a designated test account and approve only this device code. Check restart, offline/reconnect, revocation and safe recovery without recording tokens or overwriting original files.
Create a minimal native project, edit, undo/redo, save to a new folder and reopen. Import/export an advertised supported format and inspect the output. Record unsupported features honestly.

Check that only the correct Pixa product feed is used. No matching release should say no newer update. Actual signed install/restart is a separate post-notarization gate; never disable OS verification.

note: This checklist is a testing aid, not evidence that the candidate is already packaged, fully documented or accepted.
